note_on_method: Each venue page rests on one line of the City of Wichita's Pickleball page - a name, a street line, in most cases a phone number, and a count, under one of three tabs whose headings say whether the courts are indoor or outdoor - plus the US Census address geocoder and OpenStreetMap for the county and the postcode. The page could not be fetched by any script, so it was read in a browser on 7 September 2026 and saved as text; every line quoted below is asserted against that file on every build. Where the City is silent, these pages record the silence, and where the Census added a compass direction the City does not write, they say which resolver's answer is published and why.

slots.description:
Fifteen pickleball courts at one address, and the largest count in Wichita. The City writes this venue twice on its Pickleball page. On the Parks tab, under the heading "Outdoor courts with hard / concrete surfaces", the line is "Edgemoor Park / 5815 E 9th / 12 courts". On the Recreation Centers tab, under "Temporary indoor courts with wood and tile surfaces", it is "Edgemoor / 5815 E 9th Street / 316-688-9392 / 3 courts". Same address, one site, and this page adds the two counts to fifteen and prints both lines so the sum can be checked.

Twelve outdoor courts is the largest outdoor set in the city by a distance - Seneca Park's six is next - and the three indoor courts in the centre put Edgemoor on both the outdoor and the indoor pages, as Riverside Tennis Center is. The City says nothing else about the place: no hours for the park, no drop-in times for the centre beyond two PDFs not read for this page, no lighting, no price, and no surface for this venue on its own, because the two materials in each heading are shared across every venue under it.
slots.getting_there:
5815 E 9th, Wichita, KS 67208, as the Parks tab writes it; the Recreation Centers tab writes "5815 E 9th Street". OpenStreetMap matched the address at house-number level as "5815, East 9th Street North, Country Side, Minneha, Wichita, Sedgwick County, Kansas, 67208". The US Census geocoder answered "5815 E 9TH ST N", adding a North the City does not write, so the address publishes as the City writes it, resolved through OpenStreetMap, in Sedgwick County inside the incorporated place Wichita.

The City publishes nothing about parking or restrooms. The phone number on the centre's line is 316-688-9392, and with the drop-in hours unread it is the only published way to ask.
slots.what_to_expect:
Two kinds of court and one City record for each. Outdoors, twelve courts with no stated hours, no stated lighting and no stated price - enough for a full rotation, and the one outdoor set in Wichita where turning up alone is a reasonable plan on the count alone. Indoors, three courts the City calls temporary, which means they are laid out in the centre for drop-in sessions rather than built into the floor; the sessions are in the City's summer and fall drop-in PDFs, which this site has not read, so no time is published here.

The imported record for this park held twelve courts and no indoor count, and the City's page raised it to fifteen; a count that changed is re-read at the next cadence rather than trusted once. The City's cost sentence - "Some can be reserved for a small fee while others are first-come-first-serve" - does not say which Edgemoor is, so the fee is unstated. Nothing is said about when the outdoor courts are busy, or whether nets are provided.

551 Nims, Wichita, KS 67203. The US Census address geocoder matched "551 NIMS ST, WICHITA, KS, 67203" at house-number level and placed it in Sedgwick County, inside the incorporated place Wichita city; the street type is the only thing the Census adds, and no second resolver was needed. Riverside is the only published Wichita venue in 67203.

The City publishes nothing about parking or restrooms. It does publish a phone number, 316-337-9257, on the same line as the counts, and a "Reserve a Pickleball Court" link, which together make this the best-documented way to arrange a game anywhere on the City's page.
slots.what_to_expect:
Nine outdoor courts under lights, which the City states as "for night play", and six indoor courts sharing a floor with tennis. That is the most any Wichita venue tells you before you arrive, and it is still short of hours: the City prints no opening or closing time for the centre, and no schedule for the indoor courts.

On cost, this is where the City's one sentence comes closest to landing. "Some can be reserved for a small fee while others are first-come-first-serve" is written for the whole city, and the "Reserve a Pickleball Court" link sits on this tab; but the fee itself is not printed, so no price publishes here. Nine lit courts is a rotation after dark, the only one in Wichita with a published lighting answer. Six double-striped indoor courts exist when the tennis courts are free, and the City does not say when that is. Ring 316-337-9257 or use the reservation link; the surface of the outdoor courts is not stated.

faqs.a: Fifteen: "9 outdoors with court lights for night play" and "6 indoors (these are double-striped over the 3 tennis courts)", in the City's words. This site adds the two.
The nine outdoor courts are, on the City's own line, "with court lights for night play". The six indoor courts are inside. This is the only lighting statement the City makes in Wichita.

faqs.q: Can I reserve a court, and what does it cost?
faqs.a: The City links "Reserve a Pickleball Court" from this tab and says some Wichita courts "can be reserved for a small fee". No price is printed, so none is published here.
The six indoor courts are pickleball lines laid over the three indoor tennis courts, so they share a floor with tennis and exist when tennis is not on it.

faqs.q: Why is the older name not used?
faqs.a: The imported dataset holds "Ralph Wulz Riverside Tennis Center" with thirteen courts. The City's page prints "Riverside Tennis Center" and fifteen, and the City's record publishes.

sources.evidence: The City's Pickleball page, read in a browser on 2026-09-07 because wichita.gov answers HTTP 403 to scripted fetches. Introduction: "Wichita Parks and Recreation offers indoor and outdoor pickleball courts all over the city. Some can be reserved for a small fee while others are first-come-first-serve." Recreation Centers tab, under "Temporary indoor courts with wood and tile surfaces", with links "View Summer Drop-In Hours (PDF)" and "View Fall Drop-In Hours (PDF)": "Boston / 6655 E Zimmerly / 316-688-9301 / 3 courts", "Edgemoor / 5815 E 9th Street / 316-688-9392 / 3 courts", "Evergreen / 2700 N Woodland / 316-909-8036 / 2 courts", "Linwood / 1901 S Kansas / 316-337-9191 / 3 courts", "Brewer (Closed for Improvements) / 1329 E 16th Street / 316-337-9222 / 2 courts", "Orchard / 4808 W 9th Street / 316-337-9244 / 3 courts". Riverside Tennis Center tab: "551 Nims / Phone: 316-337-9257 / 9 outdoors with court lights for night play / 6 indoors (these are double-striped over the 3 tennis courts)", with links "Reserve a Pickleball Court" and "Take Pickleball Lessons". Parks tab, under "Outdoor courts with hard / concrete surfaces": "Edgemoor Park / 5815 E 9th / 12 courts", "Buffalo Park / 10201 Hardtner / 2 courts", "Osage Park / 2121 W 31st / 2 courts", "Seneca Park / 202 S Seneca / 6 courts", "Sherwood Glen / 1 striped without net (portable net required)". Snapshot: data/sources/wichita/pickleball.txt
sources.not_stated: Hours at any venue beyond Brewer's closure, lighting anywhere but Riverside, a price or a free answer for any named venue, a surface for any single venue, parking, restrooms, whether nets are provided, and any address for Sherwood Glen.

sources.evidence: All ten published addresses were matched at house-number level and placed in Sedgwick County, KS, inside the incorporated place Wichita. Five resolved through the Census address file as the City writes them: Buffalo Park "10201 HARDTNER ST, WICHITA, KS, 67212", Seneca Park "202 S SENECA ST, WICHITA, KS, 67213", Boston "6655 E ZIMMERLY ST, WICHITA, KS, 67207", Linwood "1901 S KANSAS AVE, WICHITA, KS, 67211", Riverside Tennis Center "551 NIMS ST, WICHITA, KS, 67203". Four resolved through OpenStreetMap because the Census appended a compass direction the City does not write: Edgemoor Park "5815, East 9th Street North, Country Side, Minneha, Wichita, Sedgwick County, Kansas, 67208" against the Census's "5815 E 9TH ST N"; Osage Park "2121, West 31st Street South, Wichita, Sedgwick County, Kansas, 67217" against the Census's "2121 W 31ST ST N, WICHITA, KS, 67204"; Brewer "1329, East 16th Street North, Woodridge, Wichita, Sedgwick County, Kansas, 67214" against "1329 E 16TH ST N"; Orchard "Orchard Park Recreation Center, 4808, West 9th Street North, Wichita, Sedgwick County, Kansas, 67212" against "4808 W 9TH ST N". Evergreen stands on the Census answer "2700 WOODLAND ST, WICHITA, KS, 67204", which drops the City's N, because OpenStreetMap holds nothing for the address as written. Snapshot: data/sources/wichita-county-census.json
